messages:
raj: Heads-up: CumulusCorp renewal invoice INV-2026-3342 for their private/on-prem deployment shows a mysterious -$119,850 'platform fee adjustment' credit. We did not authorize a credit for this customer.
emily: Which contract term is that for? March 1 start or a backdate?
raj: Renewal effective 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28. They signed an amendment that changed committed GPUs and asked for a 2026-02-01 effective date on the amendment. Legal approved backdate. Expectation from account was a true-up charge, not a credit.
olga: tagging billing-bot for metering + true-up logic check.
billing-bot: automated note: invoice line matched event CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_6543. System applied PRO_RATA_PLATFORM_ADJUSTMENT with negative sign due to delta sign inversion in amendment import. Suggest manual review and reversal.
emily: If the platform backdated effective date then billing window alignment matters. Raj, did the amendment reduce or increase committed capacity?
raj: They reduced commit (ramp down). But we should have billed the delta as a pro-rata charge in Feb, not issued a net negative invoice across March.
mike: This produces a negative net invoice (-$68,350 net due) which will confuse the customer and break revenue recognition. Need approval to reverse and reissue.
emily: I pulled the invoice lines: ```INV-2026-3342:
- PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY: $45,000
- SUPPORT_TIER_ENTERPRISE: $6,500
- PLATFORM_FEE_ADJUSTMENT: -$119,850
- NET_DUE: -$68,350```
olga: Looks like the import routine flipped the sign for decreases. The adjustment equals prior-period pro-rata that should have been invoiced positively. I'll open a BillingOps ticket to reverse.
mike: Approve reversal + corrected invoice issuance. Finance and RevOps to coordinate journal entries and customer communication. Raj, please draft the note to the customer.
raj: Drafting now: "Apologies — we issued an incorrect credit on your renewal invoice due to an import error. We'll issue a corrected invoice and reversal shortly. Please hold any payment actions; contact me directly for questions"
emily: Also recommend a quick engineering safety check: ensure amendment import preserves delta sign and add a unit test. I'll create ENG-BILL-411 for the fix.
billing-bot: tasks created: BILL-7382 (BillingOps: reversal workflow), ENG-BILL-411 (engineering: delta sign test).
olga: I'll own the reversal workflow. Creating reversal invoice for INV-2026-3342 and issuing corrected invoice with positive true-up. ETA: EOD today pending REVOPS approval.
mike: If customer escalates to legal, escalate to me. Also tag accounting to expect revenue restatement for the period. :thumbsup: 
raj: Thanks. I will post the customer-facing note in #customer-success before sending. Will update thread when reversal/credit note issued."
